verdict.rationale: Figma's MCP server and REST/Plugin APIs let an agent extract layer/object data, generate code from frames, and even push live UI into Figma files (figma-docs-1,3,5,7,8), and the REST API exposes read access to file/layer data programmatically (figma-docs-7,26). However, there is no documented programmatic surface for rendering/exporting images or production-format screenshots via the MCP server itself — the REST API's image export endpoint isn't cited, and MCP docs focus on code/context generation rather than image/PNG/SVG export. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an image/screenshot export endpoint reachable by an agent (e.g., REST API's image rendering endpoint) being surfaced through the MCP server or agent-facing tool, and independent confirmation that agents can retrieve rendered exports (not just layer data or code) through this surface.
